verses.original: רָנִּ֥י עֲקָרָ֖ה לֹ֣א יָלָ֑דָה פִּצְחִ֨י רִנָּ֤ה וְצַהֲלִי֙ לֹא־ חָ֔לָה כִּֽי־ רַבִּ֧ים בְּֽנֵי־ שׁוֹמֵמָ֛ה מִבְּנֵ֥י בְעוּלָ֖ה אָמַ֥ר יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: rān·nî ‘ă·qā·rāh lō yā·lā·ḏāh piṣ·ḥî rin·nāh wə·ṣa·hă·lî lō- ḥā·lāh kî- rab·bîm bə·nê- šō·w·mê·māh mib·bə·nê ḇə·‘ū·lāh ’ā·mar Yah·weh
verses.literal: Shout for joy O barren woman vvv who bears no children break forth in song and cry aloud you who have never travailed because more [are] the children of the desolate woman [than] of her who has a husband says the LORD

verses.original: הַרְחִ֣יבִי׀ מְק֣וֹם אָהֳלֵ֗ךְ יַטּ֖וּ וִירִיע֧וֹת מִשְׁכְּנוֹתַ֛יִךְ אַל־ תַּחְשֹׂ֑כִי הַאֲרִ֙יכִי֙ מֵֽיתָרַ֔יִךְ וִיתֵדֹתַ֖יִךְ חַזֵּֽקִי׃
verses.transliteration: har·ḥî·ḇî mə·qō·wm ’ā·ho·lêḵ yaṭ·ṭū wî·rî·‘ō·wṯ miš·kə·nō·w·ṯa·yiḵ ’al- taḥ·śō·ḵî ha·’ă·rî·ḵî mê·ṯā·ra·yiḵ wî·ṯê·ḏō·ṯa·yiḵ ḥaz·zê·qî
verses.literal: Enlarge the site of your tent stretch out the curtains of your dwellings do not hold back Lengthen your ropes and drive your stakes in deep . . .

verses.original: כִּי־ תִּפְרֹ֑צִי יָמִ֥ין וּשְׂמֹ֖אול וְזַרְעֵךְ֙ יִירָ֔שׁ גּוֹיִ֣ם יוֹשִֽׁיבוּ׃ נְשַׁמּ֖וֹת וְעָרִ֥ים
verses.transliteration: kî- tip̄·rō·ṣî yā·mîn ū·śə·mō·wl wə·zar·‘êḵ yî·rāš gō·w·yim yō·wō·šî·ḇū nə·šam·mō·wṯ wə·‘ā·rîm
verses.literal: For you will spread out to the right and left your descendants will dispossess the nations and inhabit the desolate cities

verses.original: אַל־ תִּֽירְאִי֙ כִּי־ לֹ֣א תֵב֔וֹשִׁי וְאַל־ תִּכָּלְמִ֖י כִּ֣י לֹ֣א תַחְפִּ֑ירִי כִּ֣י תִּשְׁכָּ֔חִי בֹ֤שֶׁת עֲלוּמַ֙יִךְ֙ תִזְכְּרִי־ לֹ֥א עֽוֹד׃ וְחֶרְפַּ֥ת אַלְמְנוּתַ֖יִךְ
verses.transliteration: ’al- tî·rə·’î kî- lō ṯê·ḇō·wō·šî wə·’al- tik·kā·lə·mî kî lō ṯaḥ·pî·rî kî tiš·kā·ḥî ḇō·šeṯ ‘ă·lū·ma·yiḵ ṯiz·kə·rî- lō ‘ō·wḏ wə·ḥer·paṯ ’al·mə·nū·ṯa·yiḵ
verses.literal: Do not be afraid for you will not be put to shame do not be intimidated for you will not be humiliated For you will forget the shame of your youth and will remember no more the reproach of your widowhood

verses.original: כִּ֤י בֹעֲלַ֙יִךְ֙ עֹשַׂ֔יִךְ יְהוָ֥ה צְבָא֖וֹת שְׁמ֑וֹ קְד֣וֹשׁ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְגֹֽאֲלֵךְ֙ יִקָּרֵֽא׃ אֱלֹהֵ֥י כָל־ הָאָ֖רֶץ
verses.transliteration: kî ḇō·‘ă·la·yiḵ ‘ō·śa·yiḵ Yah·weh ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ šə·mōw qə·ḏō·wōš yiś·rā·’êl wə·ḡō·’ă·lêḵ yiq·qā·rê ’ĕ·lō·hê ḵāl hā·’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: For your husband is your Maker the LORD of Hosts [is] His name the Holy One of Israel is your Redeemer He is called the God of all the earth

verses.original: כִּֽי־ יְהוָ֑ה קְרָאָ֣ךְ כְאִשָּׁ֧ה עֲזוּבָ֛ה וַעֲצ֥וּבַת ר֖וּחַ כִּ֥י תִמָּאֵ֖ס וְאֵ֧שֶׁת נְעוּרִ֛ים אָמַ֥ר אֱלֹהָֽיִךְ׃
verses.transliteration: kî- Yah·weh qə·rā·’āḵ ḵə·’iš·šāh ‘ă·zū·ḇāh wa·‘ă·ṣū·ḇaṯ rū·aḥ kî ṯim·mā·’ês wə·’ê·šeṯ nə·‘ū·rîm ’ā·mar ’ĕ·lō·hā·yiḵ
verses.literal: For the LORD has called you back like a wife deserted and wounded in spirit like the rejected wife of one’s youth says your God

verses.original: קָטֹ֖ן בְּרֶ֥גַע עֲזַבְתִּ֑יךְ גְּדֹלִ֖ים וּבְרַחֲמִ֥ים אֲקַבְּצֵֽךְ׃
verses.literal: For a brief moment I forsook you but with great compassion I will bring you back

verses.original: בְּשֶׁ֣צֶף קֶ֗צֶף הִסְתַּ֨רְתִּי פָנַ֥י מִמֵּ֔ךְ רֶ֙גַע֙ עוֹלָ֖ם וּבְחֶ֥סֶד רִֽחַמְתִּ֑יךְ אָמַ֥ר יְהוָֽה׃ס גֹּאֲלֵ֖ךְ
verses.transliteration: bə·še·ṣep̄ qe·ṣep̄ his·tar·tî p̄ā·nay mim·mêḵ re·ḡa‘ ‘ō·w·lām ū·ḇə·ḥe·seḏ ri·ḥam·tîḵ ’ā·mar Yah·weh gō·’ă·lêḵ
verses.literal: In a surge of anger I hid My face from you for a moment but with everlasting kindness I will have compassion on you says the LORD your Redeemer

verses.original: כִּי־ לִ֔י זֹ֣את מֵ֥י נֹ֙חַ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר נִשְׁבַּ֗עְתִּי מֵי־ נֹ֛חַ ע֖וֹד מֵעֲבֹ֥ר עַל־ הָאָ֑רֶץ כֵּ֥ן נִשְׁבַּ֛עְתִּי מִקְּצֹ֥ף עָלַ֖יִךְ וּמִגְּעָר־ בָּֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: kî- lî zōṯ mê nō·aḥ ’ă·šer niš·ba‘·tî mê- nō·aḥ ‘ō·wḏ mê·‘ă·ḇōr ‘al- hā·’ā·reṣ kên niš·ba‘·tî miq·qə·ṣōp̄ ‘ā·la·yiḵ ū·mig·gə·‘ār- bāḵ
verses.literal: For to Me this is like vvv the days of Noah when I swore that the waters of Noah would never again cover the earth So I have sworn that I will not be angry with you or rebuke you

verses.original: כִּ֤י הֶֽהָרִים֙ יָמ֔וּשׁוּ וְהַגְּבָע֖וֹת תְּמוּטֶ֑נָה וְחַסְדִּ֞י מֵאִתֵּ֣ךְ לֹֽא־ יָמ֗וּשׁ וּבְרִ֤ית שְׁלוֹמִי֙ לֹ֣א תָמ֔וּט אָמַ֥ר יְהוָֽה׃ס מְרַחֲמֵ֖ךְ
verses.transliteration: kî he·hā·rîm yā·mū·šū wə·hag·gə·ḇā·‘ō·wṯ tə·mū·ṭe·nāh wə·ḥas·dî mê·’it·têḵ lō- yā·mūš ū·ḇə·rîṯ šə·lō·w·mî lō ṯā·mūṭ ’ā·mar Yah·weh mə·ra·ḥă·mêḵ
verses.literal: Though the mountains may be removed and the hills may be shaken My loving devotion . . . will not depart from you and My covenant of peace will not be broken says the LORD who has compassion on you

verses.original: עֲנִיָּ֥ה סֹעֲרָ֖ה לֹ֣א נֻחָ֑מָה הִנֵּ֨ה אָנֹכִ֜י מַרְבִּ֤יץ אֲבָנַ֔יִךְ בַּפּוּךְ֙ וִיסַדְתִּ֖יךְ בַּסַּפִּירִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: ‘ă·nî·yāh sō·‘ă·rāh lō nu·ḥā·māh hin·nêh ’ā·nō·ḵî mar·bîṣ ’ă·ḇā·na·yiḵ bap·pūḵ wî·saḏ·tîḵ bas·sap·pî·rîm
verses.literal: O afflicted city lashed by storms without solace surely I will set your stones in antimony and lay your foundations with sapphires

verses.original: וְשַׂמְתִּ֤י שִׁמְשֹׁתַ֔יִךְ כַּֽדְכֹד֙ וּשְׁעָרַ֖יִךְ אֶקְדָּ֑ח לְאַבְנֵ֣י וְכָל־ גְּבוּלֵ֖ךְ חֵֽפֶץ׃ לְאַבְנֵי־
verses.transliteration: wə·śam·tî šim·šō·ṯa·yiḵ kaḏ·ḵōḏ ū·šə·‘ā·ra·yiḵ ’eq·dāḥ lə·’aḇ·nê wə·ḵāl gə·ḇū·lêḵ ḥê·p̄eṣ lə·’aḇ·nê-
verses.literal: I will make your pinnacles of rubies your gates of sparkling jewels and all your walls of precious stones

verses.original: וְכָל־ בָּנַ֖יִךְ לִמּוּדֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וְרַ֖ב בָּנָֽיִךְ׃ שְׁל֥וֹם
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵāl bā·na·yiḵ lim·mū·ḏê Yah·weh wə·raḇ bā·nā·yiḵ šə·lō·wm
verses.literal: Then all your sons will be taught by the LORD and great [will be their] prosperity

verses.original: בִּצְדָקָ֖ה תִּכּוֹנָ֑נִי רַחֲקִ֤י מֵעֹ֙שֶׁק֙ כִּֽי־ לֹ֣א תִירָ֔אִי וּמִ֨מְּחִתָּ֔ה כִּ֥י לֹֽא־ תִקְרַ֖ב אֵלָֽיִךְ׃
verses.transliteration: biṣ·ḏā·qāh tik·kō·w·nā·nî ra·ḥă·qî mê·‘ō·šeq kî- lō ṯî·rā·’î ū·mim·mə·ḥit·tāh kî lō- ṯiq·raḇ ’ê·lā·yiḵ
verses.literal: In righteousness you will be established far from oppression for {you will have} no fear Terror [will be far removed] for it will not come near you

verses.original: הֵ֣ן גּ֥וֹר יָג֛וּר אֶ֖פֶס מֵֽאוֹתִ֑י מִי־ גָ֥ר אִתָּ֖ךְ יִפּֽוֹל׃ עָלַ֥יִךְ
verses.transliteration: hên gō·wr yā·ḡūr ’e·p̄es mê·’ō·w·ṯî mî- ḡār ’it·tāḵ yip·pō·wl ‘ā·la·yiḵ
verses.literal: If anyone attacks you . . . it is not from Me whoever assails you . . . will fall before you

verses.original: הֵן אָֽנֹכִי֙ בָּרָ֣אתִי חָרָ֔שׁ נֹפֵ֙חַ֙ פֶּחָ֔ם בְּאֵ֣שׁ וּמוֹצִ֥יא כְלִ֖י לְמַעֲשֵׂ֑הוּ וְאָנֹכִ֛י בָּרָ֥אתִי מַשְׁחִ֖ית לְחַבֵּֽל׃
verses.transliteration: hēn ’ā·nō·ḵî bā·rā·ṯî ḥā·rāš nō·p̄ê·aḥ pe·ḥām bə·’êš ū·mō·w·ṣî ḵə·lî lə·ma·‘ă·śê·hū wə·’ā·nō·ḵî bā·rā·ṯî maš·ḥîṯ lə·ḥab·bêl
verses.literal: Behold I have created the craftsman who fans the coals into flame and forges a weapon fit for its task and I have created the destroyer to wreak havoc

verses.original: כָּל־ לֹ֣א כְּלִ֞י יוּצַ֤ר עָלַ֙יִךְ֙ יִצְלָ֔ח תַּרְשִׁ֑יעִי וְכָל־ לָשׁ֛וֹן תָּֽקוּם־ לַמִּשְׁפָּ֖ט אִתָּ֥ךְ זֹ֡את נַחֲלַת֩ עַבְדֵ֨י יְהוָ֧ה וְצִדְקָתָ֛ם מֵאִתִּ֖י נְאֻם־ יְהוָֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: kāl- lō kə·lî yū·ṣar ‘ā·la·yiḵ yiṣ·lāḥ tar·šî·‘î wə·ḵāl lā·šō·wn tā·qūm- lam·miš·pāṭ ’it·tāḵ zōṯ na·ḥă·laṯ ‘aḇ·ḏê Yah·weh wə·ṣiḏ·qā·ṯām mê·’it·tî nə·’um- Yah·weh
verses.literal: vvv No weapon formed against you shall prosper and you will refute every tongue that accuses . . . you This is the heritage of the servants of the LORD and their vindication [is] from Me declares the LORD
